# Triple Performance

> Triple Performance is a collaborative wiki about agroecology and farming practices
> (crop systems, farm case studies, technical guides), run by Neayi. It is built on
> MediaWiki + Semantic MediaWiki and published in several languages.

If you are a crawler, a scraper or an AI agent: please do NOT crawl the HTML pages link
by link. Use the sitemap and the APIs below - it is faster for you and cheaper for us.
Page history, diffs, old revisions and most special pages are blocked for anonymous
clients, and IPs that keep requesting them get banned.

## Language editions

- French: https://wiki.tripleperformance.fr
- Other languages: https://{lang}.tripleperformance.ag with {lang} in en, de, es, it, pt, nl, pl, el, hu, fi, ar

All the paths below are relative to one of these hosts.

## Listing pages

- [Sitemap (all languages)](https://wiki.tripleperformance.fr/sitemap.xml): every indexable page, with last modification date
- All pages of a namespace: `/api.php?action=query&list=allpages&apnamespace=0&aplimit=max&format=json` (follow `continue`)
- Incremental updates: `/api.php?action=query&list=recentchanges&rcprop=title|timestamp&rclimit=max&format=json` - fetch only what changed since your last visit

## Reading content

- Page wikitext (REST): `/rest.php/v1/page/{title}`
- Page HTML (REST): `/rest.php/v1/page/{title}/html`
- Batch wikitext (up to 50 titles): `/api.php?action=query&prop=revisions&rvprop=content&rvslots=main&titles=A|B|C&format=json`
- Plain-text extract: `/api.php?action=query&prop=extracts&explaintext=1&titles={title}&format=json`

## Structured data (Semantic MediaWiki)

- Semantic queries: `/api.php?action=ask&query=[[Category:{category}]]|?{property}|limit=500&format=json`
  (use `offset` to paginate; please do not crawl Special:Ask / Special:SearchByProperty HTML pages)

## Etiquette

- Send a descriptive User-Agent with a contact URL or e-mail.
- Stay sequential (no parallel requests), around 1 request per second; add `maxlag=5` to api.php calls.
- Respect robots.txt and its Crawl-delay.
